testcase.name: Scenario: Ungroup and regroup a ribbon command family: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:354:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Ungroup and regroup a ribbon command family ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the 3D Model Work Features panel contains a grouped "Plane" command ✔ When the user right-clicks "Plane" and selects "Ungroup Commands from Drop-Down Menu" ✔ And the user opens the compact Work Features panel ✔ Then separate plane command buttons are visible including "Offset from Plane" and "Three Points" ✔ When the user right-clicks "Plane" and selects "Group Commands into Drop-Down Menu" ✔ And the user opens the Work Features panel again ✔ Then the plane choices are represented by a grouped "Plane" control ✔ And the part remains active
